verdicts.reason: Both candidates are broken the same way. The hero barrel photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail at the bottom, next to an equally tiny logo, and a stretched black bar (probably the dark strip at the top of the photo) cuts across the middle. The watercolour texture floats on its own and the headline sits in empty white space, so the brand imagery and logo hierarchy are lost. A is marginally less bad because the watercolour sits higher, leaving less dead space at the top than in B, whose larger empty top makes it look even more scattered.
